## Description

This deployment gathers the product's TFSTATE established by Platform Gainwell (`pfe-pg` repo) for the `initialize-account` and `onboard-product` deployments. A copy of the state is saved into the product-specific state bucket for access by product-specific deployments.

**Key Role**: This deployment serves as the foundation for product-specific deployments by providing access to shared infrastructure components (VPC, EKS cluster, subnets) that are managed by Platform Engineering but needed by product deployments like the RAG architecture.

## Example Use

Open a VSCode terminal and navigate to terragrunt.hcl file folder. The following commands are available:

```text
terragrunt init
terragrunt plan
terragrunt apply
terragrunt destroy
```

page_texts.7:
[.tooling/iac/terraform/deployments/aws/development/acquire-tfstate/README.md#deploy-rag]

### deploy-rag

The RAG deployment references the following acquired state outputs:

| Resource                          | Usage                                                               |
| --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `account_vpcs["shared-services"]` | VPC configuration for OpenSearch domain placement                   |
| `eks_cluster.eks`                 | EKS cluster configuration for IRSA (IAM Roles for Service Accounts) |
| Private subnets                   | OpenSearch domain subnet placement in data-tier subnets             |

**Example terragrunt dependency:**

```hcl
dependency "platform" {
  config_path = "../../acquire-tfstate/${local.region_context}"
}

# Usage in inputs
vpc_id = dependency.platform.outputs.remote_tfstates.account.outputs.account_vpcs["shared-services"].vpc_id
eks_cluster_name = dependency.platform.outputs.remote_tfstates.account.outputs.eks_cluster.eks.id
```

## State

This formation will persist IaC state in the account-level state bucket created by the [Platform Gainwell onboard-product deployment](https://github.com/mygainwell/pfe-pg/tree/main/infrastructure-as-code/terraform/deployments/aws/development/onboard-products/pfe-example).
